notes: Fixture-free evals: the agent works in an empty scratch dir, so no fixture files are referenced. Expectations are graded against the produced main.bean. bean-check via `uv run --project cli bean-check` in this repo (`pip install beancount` elsewhere).

evals.name: init-with-bea
evals.prompt: Set up a new beancount ledger here (USD, no opening balance). `bea` is on PATH.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs `bea --no-input init . --currency USD --date <TODAY>` and writes no template itself. main.bean equals `bea init` output byte-for-byte: thirteen opens dated TODAY plus the commented opening-balance example. bean-check passes.
expectations: main.bean is byte-identical to running `bea --no-input init . --currency USD --date <TODAY>` directly
main.bean opens exactly the thirteen template accounts (Checking, Savings, Cash, CreditCard, Salary, Interest, Groceries, Dining, Rent, Transport, Utilities, Fees, OpeningBalances)

evals.name: init-without-bea
evals.prompt: Set up a new beancount ledger here (EUR, checking opening balance 100). `bea` is NOT on PATH.
evals.expected_output: The skill writes the thirteen-account template itself with TODAY opens, the operating currency, and a live opening-balances transaction for Assets:Checking 100. bean-check passes.
expectations: main.bean opens exactly the thirteen template accounts dated TODAY in EUR
The equity account is spelled `Equity:OpeningBalances` with the operating currency
A live `Opening balances` transaction posts Assets:Checking 100 against Equity:OpeningBalances -100 (no commented example alongside it)
